title: alnus glutinosa f. parvifolia
intro: Alnus glutinosa f. parvifolia, commonly known as Dwarf Alder, is a variety of the Alder tree (Alnus glutinosa) that is characterized by its smaller leaves. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its potential to act as an antibacterial and anti-inflammatory agent, which can help to reduce the risk of infections and alleviate symptoms associated with conditions such as arthritis. The therapeutic actions of Alnus glutinosa f. parvifolia include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and provide antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
